development_source_freeze.physical_rule: development loader SQL must exclude season>=2023 before labels or target rows are materialized

frozen_v3_1_1_baseline_reconstruction.matrix_rule: take frozen Formal V2 0..14 x 0..14 joint base shape and I-project each H/D/A outcome region to the season-wise frozen V3.1-A probabilities
frozen_v3_1_1_baseline_reconstruction.rolling_fit: for target season s>=2019 fit the frozen USR/V3.1 residual model on seasons 2018..s-1 only; process features are PIT snapshots before kickoff
frozen_v3_1_1_baseline_reconstruction.fallback: frozen exact fallback behavior inherited unchanged

development_role_resolution.2018: V3.1 rolling-model warmup only; not score-shape scored and not residual-history scored
development_role_resolution.2019: first valid frozen-V3.1.1 score residual history; post-label release history only; not used to select by its own score
development_role_resolution.2020: only development scoring season for the preregistered 18-cell grid
development_role_resolution.2023: physically unopened until every 2021-22 hard gate passes; then one fixed diagnostic only

lookback_and_support.lookback_rule: for target season s and lookback L include only released residual records with historical season >= s-L and release_time <= target kickoff
lookback_and_support.activation_rule: both target teams must independently have at least min_effective_matches released records in the window; otherwise exact frozen V3.1.1 matrix

cell_tilt_score.zero_components: if home_goals_cell=0 include mean(home FTS residual, away CS residual); if away_goals_cell=0 include mean(away FTS residual, home CS residual); if both are zero include both zero terms; otherwise omit zero term
cell_tilt_score.margin_component: mean(home team margin residual for cell margin category, away team margin residual for the reversed category)
cell_tilt_score.raw_cell_score: arithmetic mean of all applicable components

region_projection.procedure: multiply each frozen V3.1.1 cell by its tilt factor, renormalize independently inside each outcome region back to that region's frozen V3.1.1 mass, then apply any floating residual to the largest cell in that same region

feasibility: 1X2 probabilities and Top1 exactly identical to frozen V3.1.1 within tolerance
grid_and_selection.ranking: lowest candidate exact-score logloss, then lowest total-goals RPS, then smaller shrinkage, then larger min_effective_matches, then larger lookback_seasons

metric_definitions.exact_score_logloss: mean -log P(actual home_goals,away_goals), with probability floor 1e-15; scores outside 0..14 use floor
metric_definitions.total_goals_rps: standard ordered multiclass RPS averaged over matches
metric_definitions.top1_score_accuracy: argmax 225-cell exact-score hit rate; diagnostic only
metric_definitions.folds: frozen XG chronological outer fold map, evaluated only on nonempty target rows
